terms.intro: Welcome to Al Zajel Rent Car. By renting a vehicle from us, you agree to the following Terms & Conditions. Please read them carefully before making your booking.

sections.title: Rental Requirements
items: The renter must be at least 21 years old.
A valid driving license must be provided.
A passport or Civil ID may be required for identity verification.
A security deposit may be required before the rental begins.

sections.title: Rental Period & Extensions
items: Any request to extend the rental period must be made and approved before the original rental period expires.
Additional charges may apply for late return of the vehicle.

sections.title: Use of the Vehicle
items: The vehicle must be used within Oman only.
The vehicle may not be used for racing, off-road driving, illegal activities, or any other prohibited purposes.
The renter is responsible for all traffic violations, parking fines, road tolls, and related charges incurred during the rental period.

sections.title: Insurance & Liability
items: All rental vehicles include basic insurance covering third-party liability.
In the event of an accident, the renter must notify Al Zajel Rent Car immediately and provide the required police report.
The renter is responsible for the applicable insurance excess/deductible and for any damage or costs not covered by the insurance.

sections.title: Payment & Security Deposit
items: The full rental amount must be paid at the start of the rental period.
Accepted payment methods include: Cash, Credit Card, Bank Transfer, Payment Link, and Local Debit Card.

sections.title: Cancellation & Refunds
items: Late cancellations or failure to show up for a confirmed booking (no-show) may be subject to cancellation charges.
Any applicable refund will be handled according to the company's cancellation policy.

sections.title: Vehicle Breakdown & Roadside Assistance
items: If the vehicle breaks down, the renter must contact Al Zajel Rent Car immediately for assistance.
Al Zajel Rent Car will provide a replacement vehicle where one is available.

sections.title: Traffic Violations & Fines
items: The renter is responsible for all traffic violations, parking violations, fines, and related charges incurred during the rental period.
Any damage resulting from negligence, misuse, or improper use of the vehicle will be charged to the renter.

sections.title: Chauffeur Service
items: Chauffeurs provided by Al Zajel Rent Car are trained and qualified.
The renter must follow the agreed driving schedule and destinations arranged in advance.

sections.title: Termination of the Rental Agreement
items: Al Zajel Rent Car reserves the right to terminate the rental agreement if the renter violates any of these Terms & Conditions.
In the event of termination, the vehicle must be returned immediately.

sections.title: Governing Law
items: These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman.
Any disputes arising from the rental agreement shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the Omani courts.
